findings.quote: the rise of artificial intelligence (AI). The AI revolution is progressing at lightning speed.
findings.rationale: Introduces the rapid AI revolution as a consequential development requiring adaptation.

findings.quote: We may have but a few years to adapt to the AI revolution.
findings.rationale: States an urgent time horizon for adapting to AI.

findings.quote: Yet even more disturbing is the potential eruption of AI-driven wars that could achieve an unimaginable scale.
findings.rationale: Warns of democracy and job disruption, crime, AI warfare, and loss of human control to self-teaching machines.

findings.quote: We must ensure that the promise of an AI utopia does not turn into an AI dystopia.
findings.rationale: Calls for joint action on AI dangers and describes potential health, education, transport, agriculture, energy and space benefits.

findings.quote: Our goal must be to ensure that AI brings more freedom and not less, prevents wars instead of starting them, and ensures that people live longer,
findings.rationale: Calls for responsible, ethical international shaping of AI, protecting freedom and peace; also describes national AI leadership.

findings.quote: healthier, more productive and peaceful lives. That is in our reach.
findings.rationale: Completes the preceding AI goal sentence on healthier, productive, peaceful lives.

findings.quote: As we harness the powers of AI, let us always remember the irreplaceable value of human intuition and wisdom.
findings.rationale: Urges retaining human wisdom and empathy while combining human and machine intelligence and avoiding AI perils.
